rod.name: Fishing rod
rod.desc: Keep this rod in your backpack. It is held automatically near a pond; your combat weapon returns away from water. Hook at the bite, then balance reeling with line tension. Its bamboo line snaps 60% of the time when it strains (the tension bar fills).

rod_gold.desc: A stronger rod that makes difficult fish easier to land and improves rare catches. A strained line snaps only 30% of the time.

rod_steady.name: Steady fishing rod
rod_steady.desc: A sturdy rod with a forgiving line: tension builds slowly and heavy fish feel lighter. A strained line snaps only 10% of the time, so let go of Reel when the fish surges.

pet_dg_morel.name: Little Morel
pet_dg_morel.desc: A sleepy mushroom from the Glowcap Grotto. Now and then it bursts spores or shines a glow beam.

pet_dg_owl.name: Little Bellwarden
pet_dg_owl.desc: A tiny owl with a tiny bell. It rings little chimes and drops feathers on your foes.

pet_dg_anemone.name: Little Anemone
pet_dg_anemone.desc: A wiggly sea anemone from the Coral Throne. It pops bubbles and flicks tiny tentacles.

pet_dg_bellows.name: Little Bellows

pet_dg_empress.name: Little Moon Moth
pet_dg_empress.desc: A moth with moonlight on its wings. It sends moonbeams and sprinkles stardust.

hat_colossus.name: Cinderhorn Crown
hat_colossus.desc: Two glowing horns from the Cinderpeak Colossus. Lava cannot hurt the one who wears them.

pet_colossus.name: Little Cinderpeak
pet_colossus.desc: A pebble-sized colossus that follows the explorer who landed the final blow, spitting embers at enemies.

colossus_shard.name: Cinder Heartstone
colossus_shard.desc: A warm stone that fell from the Cinderpeak Colossus. It never quite cools down.

harpoon.name: Hunting harpoon

fish_guardian.name: Lake Guardian
fish_guardian.desc: A glowing koi that guards the big meadow lake. It surfaces now and then.

egg.name: Egg
egg.desc: Laid by your chickens. Sell it, or cook an omelette or pancakes at the kitchen.

milk.name: Milk
milk.desc: From your cows. Sell it, or make a milkshake, cheese or pancakes at the kitchen.

goat_milk.name: Goat milk
goat_milk.desc: Creamy milk from your goats. Sell it or use it at the kitchen.

goose_egg.name: Goose egg
goose_egg.desc: A big goose egg. Collect from geese or sell at the market.

duck_egg.name: Duck egg
duck_egg.desc: A rich duck egg. Collect from ducks or sell at the market.

truffle.name: Garden truffle
truffle.desc: A rare treat unearthed by pigs. Heals 90 and +20% luck for 120s.

guard.name: Garden protection
guard.desc: A guard dog protects ripe crops from visitors. It never becomes meat.

omelette.name: Omelette
omelette.desc: Two eggs, folded warm. Heals 40 and +10 defense for 90s.

milkshake.name: Milkshake
milkshake.desc: Cold and frothy. Heals 45 and +25% speed for 90s.

cheese.name: Cheese wheel
cheese.desc: Three jugs of milk, aged a little. Heals 70 and +3 HP/s for 120s.

pancake.name: Pancakes
pancake.desc: An egg and a jug of milk. Heals 55 and +30% XP for 120s.

home.name: Clover Village
home.description: Your garden and four trails: forest, meadow, swamp and canyon.

candy.name: Candy Planet
candy.description: Sweet forests, springy surprises and powerful candy creatures.

ice.name: Frost Planet
ice.description: Slippery ice, frozen ponds and snowbound bosses. Plan your stopping distance.

lava.name: Volcano Planet
lava.description: Eruptions, rising lava, meteors and a hidden cave furnace. Watch the warning circles.

toy.name: Toybox Planet
toy.description: Ride the moving trains and open surprise gifts among giant toys.

jungle.name: Wild Jungle
jungle.description: Changing thorn walls, poisonous plants and restorative fruit.

ocean.name: Ocean Planet
ocean.description: Swim between islands. Refill your air at bubbles or ride a sea turtle.

cloud.name: Cloud Islands
cloud.description: Bounce between floating islands and watch the wind near their edges.

shadow.name: Night Planet
shadow.description: Explore the darkness, light ancient pillars and face the Night Lord.
